description: État des ascenseurs is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données liste l'ensemble des ascenseurs disponibles dans les gares et stations d'Île-de-France. Chaque ascenseur est présent sur une zone de correspondance du référentiel des arrêts d'Île-de-France. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Accessibilité. Its keywords are Ascenseurs, Chercheur ou journaliste, Plateforme numérique. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Mobilité (https://cloud.fabmob.io/s/eYWWJBdM3fQiFNm). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
